changelog: FIX (CRITICAL — the real Fire Stick fix): The app's JSON parser used to introspect each data class at runtime using kotlin-reflect. On Fire Stick this took up to 5 seconds per class while holding a global lock — Android would force-close the app. Switched to compile-time generated adapters via Moshi codegen + KSP, eliminating that path entirely. JSON loads are now instant on every device.
FIX (v513): Throttled the license-check loop from every 2 s back to every 30 s — reduces UI recomposition pressure 15×.
FIX: Crash reports now properly tagged with kind=anr / kind=crash so the admin dashboard can split them.
FIX: Tightened player HTTPS timeouts so playback failures show 'Reconnecting…' within 10 s instead of a 20-30 s black screen.
FIX: Resolved Google Play Protect 'harmful app' warning during install.
FIX: Player on-screen options menu D-pad selection.
FIX: Discovery hero TMDB backdrop fallback.
FIX: Settings shows $50 CAD / year correctly.
FIX: Parental Controls hide locked categories everywhere.
NEW: 72-hour free trial for first-time Canada users.
